scope_gaps.note: Only an Android help page and the RODO text were cited; other operating systems are not covered. No source says how to tell a 'required' permission from an additional one.

Art. 5 ust. 1 lit. c) binds the controller (administrator, Art. 5 ust. 2) and concerns personal data processing; it says nothing about which device permissions an app may request. The sentence does not name whom the duty binds.
The provision says 'w jak największym stopniu uwzględnia się' and 'między innymi'; the sentence says only 'uwzględnia' (less emphasis). Recital 43 (lines 516-518) gives a stronger formulation.

The page notes that some steps are possible only on a Pixel phone with Android 15 or newer (line 13) and carries a notice that the Polish text may be machine-translated (line 115). The Google attribution rests on the URL host, not on the text.

Neither source says which permissions are 'zbędne'; that is the user's own judgement. The RODO minimisation principle (Art. 5 ust. 1 lit. c)) concerns the controller's data processing, not a user's device permissions. Some steps on the Android page are limited to Pixel with Android 15 or newer.
'Uprawnienie systemowe' is stated in general terms; the cited source describes Android only.
Recital 32 (line 369) mentions choosing technical settings as a possible form of consent; not cited by the item and not equal to a statement about operating-system permissions.
Omits the intensifier 'w jak największym stopniu' and 'między innymi' of the provision.
Holds for the text of Art. 7 only. Recital 43 addresses a nearby situation (consent not voluntary when a service is conditional on unnecessary consent).

The stored regulation text is the original Official Journal publication of 4.5.2016 (L 119); later corrigenda or consolidated versions were not checked. Only Art. 4 pkt 11, 5, 6, 7, 8 and recitals 32, 43 were read for this item.
